c_Text.description: A run of interface text. Note text is never rendered with this; it lives in block components.

c_Heading.description: An interface heading for a sheet, dialog, or section.

c_Icon.description: A Fluent UI System icon. Decorative unless it has a label.

c_Button.description: A labelled action. Its label says what it does.

c_IconButton.description: An icon-only action with a required label, shown as its tooltip and accessible name.

c_Tooltip.description: Shows a control's name and shortcut. Never holds information you can't get another way.

c_SignalDot.description: The red dot. Its tone signals a save problem on the trigger.

c_TriggerButton.description: The frosted circle with the red dot. The Trigger compound places it and gives it behavior.

c_Stack.description: Children in a column, spaced by a space token.

c_Inline.description: Children in a row, spaced by a space token.

c_Surface.description: A background, border, radius, and shadow. Frost works only inside a floating Layer.

c_Layer.description: Places content on a layer (trigger, panel, dialog, toast, tooltip) at a fixed position.

c_Center.description: Centers content up to a maximum width, with the page gutter.

c_AppRoot.description: The root of every app view. Applies the theme and the token modes to the document.

c_EditorSurface.description: The writing surface (Tiptap and ProseMirror). It owns the note's DOM; views place it once.

c_Trigger.description: The trigger at the top center. Opens the toolbar, and shows a save problem in its dot.
